name: Kowloon Walled City
note: A massing model of what stood on the site until it was demolished in 1993-94, generated by tools/make-kowloon.py from published descriptions and photographs of the block; no survey, drawing or photograph is used or redistributed, and every shape is this project's own. Two and a half hectares, some three hundred and fifty buildings grown into each other, and about thirty-three thousand people. Positions are [lat, lon] against an origin at the middle of the block.

landmarks.name: The Yamen
landmarks.info: The Qing magistrate's office, put up in 1847 and the only building on the site that was ever designed. Three halls round two courtyards. The block grew over and round it for forty years and it is still there; everything else on this map was taken away in 1994.

landmarks.name: The rooftop school
landmarks.info: The roof was the only open ground the place had, and children played on it between the water tanks and the aerials with the aircraft coming over.

landmarks.name: Lung Chun Front Road
landmarks.info: One of the two lanes that crossed the block. A metre and a half wide, roofed over by the floors built out above it, lit by strip lights and running with water from the pipes overhead.

kaitak._: the approach to runway 13, which is the reason nothing here is over fourteen storeys
